promotion_gate.reason: development only; no confirmatory test evaluated

information_policy.selection: validation mean objective, <=1% MAE regression, always admit the same strong simple comparator; exact ties retain simple

GasCO.preprocessing: first eight sensors (two per sensor type); at each ten-second boundary take the latest sample at or before that boundary, at most 0.1 seconds old; duplicate source timestamps retain first occurrence; reject decreasing timestamps; longest complete contiguous grid segment, earliest on ties; relative experiment time anchored to 2000-01-01; do not use concentration setpoints

Jena2020.preprocessing: discard all duplicate timestamps and invalid/sentinel rows; choose longest contiguous complete ten-minute segment, earliest on ties; right-closed six-point hourly means; no imputation

policy.augmentation: one independently sampled acquired subset per policy origin and wait; probability uniform in [0,1]; plus empty subset

preprocessing.hourly: right-closed, right-labeled mean of six 10-minute observations; remove incomplete edge bins only; reject interior gaps

protocol.protocol_revision_before_test: Raw source timestamp inspection found jitter/duplicate exact ten-second timestamps; exact-boundary sampling was replaced by causal last-sample selection with a 100 ms age limit, before any new-dataset training or performance evaluation. No model, objective, comparator, or gate changed.
rules: Freeze this protocol before new-dataset performance is inspected; do not revise after final evaluation.
Fit forecasters on train; fit action labels on policy; choose candidates and margins on validation only.
Include forecast-only, policy-only, combined, and arrival-metadata ablations; promotion refers only to the predeclared combined method.
Apply the same origin, target, decision grid, and per-sensor acquisition costs to every sequential method.
Every method may acquire each currently unavailable origin-slot sensor once; acquisitions persist across waits; stop at deadline.
Oracle is retrospective headroom only and never a deployable competitor.
All datasets train separately; results are not zero-shot transfer or universal superiority.
All arrival timestamps and information costs are simulated. No measured deployment savings claim.
If the gate fails retain the production model, report failure, and do not retune on newly exposed tests.
This protocol is a new attempt; the previous failed gate remains unchanged.
Dataset preprocessing may inspect timestamps/missingness, never forecasting or policy test scores before freezing.
No candidate family or threshold changes after any Jena2020/GasCO test score is exposed.
For each dataset retain a six-grid-step horizon and one-grid-step deadline; simulated arrivals scale with grid length, objective weights do not change.
Primary information policy uses depth two and one ensemble standard deviation penalty; myopic and no-penalty versions are ablations only.
Ensemble spread is a heuristic and is never called a confidence bound.
Legacy training eagerly writes unused legacy test scores; full candidate family and code are frozen before that operation, and fitting/selection never consume those scores.
